title: US importer reporting: when a report is owed, to whom, and by when
plain: Death or serious injury the device caused or contributed to, or a malfunction likely to harm if it recurred: an importer reports in 30 calendar days, to FDA and the manufacturer, or to the manufacturer only for a malfunction.
law_in_force_from: 21 CFR Part 803 as in force at awareness (for your consultant to confirm)

change.reason: B9 Part C (B9-D10): the importer's floor, questions 1 to 5 reused from US-floor-1, 30 calendar days, no 5-work-day report.

review.note: Starter, for your consultant to confirm.

approval.note: B9 spec approved 11 Nov 2026 (B9-D8, D10, D11, D12): role floors, starter, from the start.

question_set.title: US importer reporting (21 CFR 803.40)
question_set.note: Questions 1 to 5 of the manufacturer's set, word for word. Question 6 (5-work-day report) is not asked: 21 CFR 803.53 applies to manufacturers.

notes.text: Importer report: 30 calendar days (21 CFR 803.40), to FDA with a copy to the manufacturer for a death or serious injury, to the manufacturer only for a malfunction. No 5-work-day report: 803.53 applies to manufacturers. Starter rule, for your consultant to confirm.
An Unknown answer could make the event reportable: the suggestion stays pending information, and "not reportable" cannot be concluded until it is answered.

folding.why: Not asked: no death and no serious injury

counting.words: from the day after awareness; US Eastern time or yours, whichever ends first

provisional.ruled_out: the role has one report period
